source_dictionary.arbitrary probability sample space: Explicit measurable-space and filtration arguments; no StandardBorelSpace hypothesis.
source_dictionary.predictable residual and drift: Inherited exact residual_sub_drift equality connects literal residual and drift sums to actual conditional-expectation-centered sums. Changing predictions p cancel pointwise.
source_dictionary.time and registered rules: Actual tail plus telescoping alpha/[t(t+1)] allocation; arbitrary Countable J with summable positive NNReal budgets.
source_dictionary.general interval: Actual affine conditional expectation; rulewise lower and nonnegative width, including width zero.
source_dictionary.finite/countable transport: Finite version has literal finite budget sum. Equivalence transport preserves summability, exact tsum and simultaneous event.
source_dictionary.selected time: One pathwise simultaneous event covers data-selected positive finite times and registered rules.
